text_sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् । असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥ १३-१५ ॥
itrans: sarvendriyaguNAbhAsaM sarvendriyavivarjitam . asakta.n sarvabhR^ichchaiva nirguNaM guNabhoktR^i cha .. 13-15 ..
translation: It illuminates the powers of all the senses; it is destitute of all the organs (formed of Prakriti), it is unaffected, it enjoys everything (devours everything), [it supports everything], it is without qualities (of Prakriti); and it enjoys all excellence (i.e., all excellent qualities.)
